lines.text: Once a match has been processed it turns up in your matches list.
Opening one gives you the whole match back with the dead time already cut out.
Double tap the right of the screen to skip to the next point, and the left to go back one.
Hold the right side and it runs at 2x speed, only while you hold it.
Hold the left side for 0.25x speed, to see what your hand actually did.
Pinch to zoom in on the table, and drag to move around.
And you can jump straight to any point in the match without scrubbing for it.
Once the match is scored, the running score sits in the bottom left as it plays.
Star a rally you want to come back to, or leave a note on it, without leaving the video.
